notes: Adds new files under src/Playnite.Core/Addons and the host entry-type probe without editing the p3-005 parser, fixtures or manifest tests. AddonManifestValidator reuses ManifestSerialization read-only against tests/golden/manifests and tests/fixtures/manifests-v10, restores the v10 default GenericPlugin only when the oracle-captured extension manifest omits Type, and returns stable per-case diagnostics with the offending member path. AddonInstallLayout defines the deterministic Extensions/<id>/<version> target; GetInstalled discovers extension.yaml recursively under the root, so both the v10 <id>/extension.yaml layout and the versioned layout are visible, with symlinked directories and manifests refused and discovery bounded to 8 levels. AddonInstaller requires an injected IRegularFileProbe and rejects a FIFO, socket or device instead of copying it (Linux openat(O_PATH|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK)+statx), installs a validated unpacked package, rejects duplicate ids, manifest/version mismatches, symlinks and unsafe entries, rolls back the whole id directory when a later copy fails, and uninstalls the whole id directory with a residue check. The installed extension.yaml and module stay under the recursive discovery root used by v10 ExtensionFactory and the p6-009 IPlayniteExtension host contract. Theme installation and theme discovery are deferred: v10 installs Themes/<Mode>/<id>/theme.yaml and discovers it non-recursively, which this extensions-root layout cannot model; ValidateTheme remains the theme document boundary. No store, network, download, update or package execution path.
